source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Rh blood group system (PDF 94-95).

blocks.text: Rh system insanon ka doosra sab se ahem blood group system hai. Is ka naam Rhesus bandar se hai jis mein Landsteiner ne is ka antigen pehli baar daryaft kiya; kitab ise 1930s ki dahai batati hai, aur aam taur par yeh daryaft 1940 mein Landsteiner aur Wiener se mansoob hai. Yeh nizam Rh antigen, jise Rh factor ya antigen-D bhi kehte hain, ki maujoodgi ya ghair maujoodgi par hai: jin mein yeh ho woh Rh-positive aur jin mein na ho woh Rh-negative.

Blood group aam taur par dono nizam saath batata hai: antigen-A aur Rh antigen wala shakhs A-positive, aur antigen-A lekin Rh antigen ke baghair A-negative; groups B, AB aur O ke naam bhi isi tarah hain.
Gene D ke do alleles hain: dominant D Rh antigen banata hai, aur kitab recessive d ko is ke ban'ne mein rukawat batati hai; yaani dd shakhs Rh antigen nahi banata.

blocks.alt: Chaar ABO groups ka table. Group A: genotype IA IA ya IA i, red cell par chokor A antigens, anti-B antibody. Group B: IB IB ya IB i, tikoni B antigens, anti-A. Group AB: IA IB, dono antigens, koi antibody nahi. Group O: i i, koi antigen nahi, anti-A aur anti-B. Neeche: DD ya Dd Rh-positive, dd Rh-negative; O-negative universal donor aur AB-positive universal recipient.
blocks.caption: Rh wali satrein aur universal donor aur recipient (Figure 18.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chromosome 9 par I gene ke teen alleles hain: IA antigen A banata, IB antigen B, aur i koi nahi; IA aur IB co-dominant aur dono i par dominant hain. Plasma mein us ABO antigen ke khilaf antibodies hoti hain jo shakhs mein nahi: group A mein anti-B, group B mein anti-A, group AB mein koi nahi aur group O mein dono. Rh system mein allele D Rh (D) antigen deta hai, is liye DD aur Dd Rh-positive aur dd Rh-negative; anti-Rh antibodies sirf tab banti hain jab Rh-negative shakhs Rh-positive cells se milta hai. O-negative red cells par A, B ya Rh antigen nahi, is liye kisi ko bhi diye ja sakte hain; AB-positive plasma mein anti-A, anti-B ya anti-Rh nahi, is liye yeh har group le sakta hai.

blocks.text: Rh system mein transfusion ka usool

Anti-A aur anti-B antibodies plasma mein pehle se hoti hain, lekin Rh-negative logon mein qudrati taur par anti-Rh antibodies nahi hotin. Agar Rh-negative shakhs ko Rh-positive khoon diya jaye to jism anti-Rh antibodies banane lagta hai jo diye gaye red cells tabah karti aur umr bhar jism mein rehti hain.

blocks.title: Asal universal donor aur recipient
blocks.text: O-negative asal universal donor hai kyunke is par ABO ka koi antigen aur Rh antigen nahi. AB-positive asal universal recipient hai kyunke is mein anti-A, anti-B ya anti-Rh antibodies nahi, is liye yeh kisi bhi donor ka khoon le sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Rh-negative shakhs pehli Rh-positive transfusion par rad-e-amal kyun nahi karta lekin doosri par kar sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Qudrati anti-Rh antibodies nahi hotin, is liye pehla saamna sirf un ka banna shuru karta hai; phir antibodies umr bhar rehti aur baad mein diye gaye Rh-positive cells par hamla karti hain.
